typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	CompletenessCheckToTEST as string ('wfsrs@wellsfargo.com'),
	DataChecksMessage as string ('The following files and records were loaded with missing fields:    The affected files need to be regenerated by Catalyst Support with complete data and reloaded.'),
	sFROM as string ('WFSOpsReportingAndSolutions@wellsfargo.com'),
	sSubject as string ('WFSR&S_ProcessAlert_DEV_CatalystTrade_ETL')
}

source(output(
		createdDate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> genericselectGETDATEsqlstatement
genericselectGETDATEsqlstatement derive(FromLine = toString($sFROM),
		Subject = toString($sSubject) + '_IncompleteCatalystDataLoad_FAILURE_RemedyASAP_' + left(toString(currentTimestamp()), 23),
		ToLine = toString($CompletenessCheckToTEST),
		Body = toString($DataChecksMessage) + '  Component: Catalyst Daily Trades ETL') ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		FromLine as string,
		ToLine as string,
		Body as string,
		Subject as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		FromLine,
		ToLine,
		Body,
		Subject)) ~> toFileExportConMgr2
